review:
The chilli-bell classic on 100 fixed lines. Expanding wilds help complete wins, scatters pay anywhere, and bonus symbols start a Hold and Win with multipliers up to 15x.

Chance x2 lets you speed up the bonus for a slightly higher stake. Medium-low volatility, 5,000x max and 97% RTP, with the bonus arriving about once every 119 spins. Steady and good value.
pros: Excellent 97.00% RTP – among the highest published
Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Bonus lands relatively often (about 1 in 119 spins on average)
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
